slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: groups
slots.about: id, label; one section each, in this order

slots.name: habits
slots.about: id (1..9), group (a group id), label, target per week

slots.name: marks
slots.about: saved: id, habit, date; one per habit per done day

slots.name: day_letters
slots.about: 7 short day names, Sunday first; the row starts where the phone's locale starts the week

slots.name: open_word
slots.about: spoken for a past or today day not done

slots.name: later_word
slots.about: spoken for a day still to come

slots.name: of_word
slots.about: spoken between count and target, with spaces

week.shows: each group as a section, each habit a card with count/target ring and the week's days: done filled with a tick, today tinted, later days faded

tap.shows: a tap on today or a past day of this week marks or unmarks it; later days do nothing; undoable

labels.day: day name and done_word, open_word or later_word

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and smooth
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a done day carries a tick and is spoken done; later days are spoken later
